checks: Reverse-apply proof: for zh-CN, ru, vi, ur and hi the 14 applied values were undone one line at a time and the resulting file hashed to the sha256 recorded by the round-1 audit (07b867bd…, 64c7edfef…, ca0a9c774…, 60e3a2aaa…, c51c89590…). The line-level diff of each reverse-applied file against the file on disk is exactly the applied edits (3/3/3/4/1 lines). fr and es are byte-identical to their round-1 hashes. Nothing else moved.

Placeholders and ICU structure: every audited value was parsed with the project's own parser (@formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser). {actor}, {targets} and {count} survive exactly as in English; no renamed, added or dropped argument, and no plural argument other than {count}.

Plural arms: ru one/few/many/other, fr/es one/many/other, ur/hi one/other, zh-CN/vi other-only — each locale uses exactly the categories its guide records, and every arm uses # where the English uses it. No locale encodes a category it does not have.

Renders: every audited value rendered with intl-messageformat at 1 and 3 targets (targets joined by Intl.ListFormat conjunction, the app's joinNames()) and events.others at counts 1/2/3/5/11/21; the truncated real path (5 names, 3 hidden, others as the list's last element) was rendered for all seven locales. Output in truncation-render.txt.

Encoding hygiene: NFC throughout, no combining-mark sequences (vi's NFC rule), and zero bidi control characters, zero-width characters or ZWNJ/ZWJ in the ur values (the render layer applies FSI/PDI; manual controls would double-apply). Per-key scan in bidi-nfc-scan.txt.

Quote style: none of the 14 changed values contains a quotation mark, so no locale's shipped quote convention can be violated by this delta; the namespace census (zh-CN/vi/ur/hi “ ”, ru « », fr « » with ’, es “ ”) is recorded for the next round that introduces quotes.

Glossary consistency: ur's term alignment مسترد → انکار now matches invitations.decline/declining/declined and leaves no مسترد in the namespace; ur's اراکین → ارکان matches the 8 other ارکان uses in the namespace and zero اراکین anywhere in the ur catalogues; zh-CN keeps 智能体/成员/静音/讨论串; hi keeps अन्य + लोग; vi keeps tác nhân/thành viên; ru keeps агент/приглашение.

Register: zh-CN 你, ru вы, vi bạn, ur آپ, hi आप — no address form appears in a changed value except zh-CN's 你自己的智能体 in the unchanged clauses of invitation_note_v3, which matches the rest of the locale.

This round audited catalogue text only: no rendered-frame, font-fallback, geometry or activation evidence is claimed, and no release approval. The ru events.joined / events.owner_added_agent and vi events.owner_added_agent overflow flags need a rendered width check on the one-line row.
